principles: Agents submit structured intent, never SQL.
Every returned fact can carry source, confidence, and freshness metadata.
Unknown and stale are explicit states, not empty strings.
Query limits are enforced by the service.

tools.name: entityscope_query
tools.description: Find entities using a natural-language query translated into allow-listed filters.

tools.name: entityscope_get_entity
tools.description: Return one entity and field-level provenance by stable identifier or slug.

tools.name: entityscope_list_sources
tools.description: List sources, field counts, and verification timestamps.

tools.name: entityscope_health
tools.description: Return row counts, enrichment progress, and staleness state.

safety.queryGeneration: Translate only to allow-listed filter keys, then bind values as parameters.
safety.recommendedAuthentication: Require authenticated transport and per-tool authorization outside a trusted host.
